title: The Lord Is My Shepherd

questions.question: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 23:1 (ESV): "The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want."

questions.question: He makes me lie down in what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 23:2 (ESV): "He makes me lie down in green pastures."

questions.question: He leads me beside what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 23:2 (ESV): "He leads me beside still waters."

questions.question: He leads me in paths of righteousness for his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 23:3 (ESV): "...He leads me in paths of righteousness for his name's sake."

questions.question: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 23:4 (ESV): "Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil,"

questions.question: For you are with me; your rod and your staff, they do what to me?
questions.explanation: Psalm 23:4 (ESV): "...for you are with me; your rod and your staff, they comfort me."

questions.question: You prepare a table before me in the presence of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 23:5 (ESV): "You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies;"

questions.question: You anoint my head with what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 23:5 (ESV): "you anoint my head with oil;"

questions.question: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me when?
options: All the days of my life
questions.correctAnswer: All the days of my life
questions.explanation: Psalm 23:6 (ESV): "Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life,"

questions.question: And I shall dwell in the house of the Lord when?
questions.explanation: Psalm 23:6 (ESV): "...and I shall dwell in the house of the Lord forever."

questions.question: Psalm 23 is traditionally attributed to whom?
What two items of the shepherd comfort the psalmist?
questions.explanation: Psalm 23:4 (ESV): "...your rod and your staff, they comfort me."

questions.question: The phrase "shadow of death" is sometimes translated as what?
questions.explanation: The Hebrew word 'sal-ma-wet' can be translated as "deep darkness" or "shadow of death". ESV text says "shadow of death" with a footnote "Or deep darkness".

key_verse_text: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.
